headline: Drone strikes hit CPC Black Sea terminal overnight; oil loadings suspended, 3rd time in a month
gist: 2 tankers hit near CPC's Novorossiysk terminal; Kazakh export flow halted; WTI $85.68 (+2.50%), broke above 85.50-85.90 supply toward day high $86.45

headline: Trump shortens Russia ceasefire deadline; OPEC+ set to approve +188k b/d for August
gist: Sanctions-waiver risk on Russian oil rising as Trump shortens deadline; OPEC+ (7 members) expected to approve a further 188,000 b/d output hike at its Aug 2 meeting

headline: Fed holds rates at 3.50-3.75% under new Chair Warsh; 3 dissents for a hike
gist: Fed held steady 9-3 on July 29; Chair Kevin Warsh gave no forward guidance; DXY firmed to ~100.19, 10Y yield 4.67%, 30Y near 19-yr high 5.24% - pressuring gold/silver into the weekend

headline: EIA nat-gas storage builds smaller-than-expected +28 bcf
gist: Week ended Jul 24: +28 bcf vs +37 bcf expected (above 5-yr avg +26 bcf); supportive, but cooler weather forecasts across central/eastern US capped upside; NG=F $2.723 (-1.27%)

headline: Gold/silver pull back from highs but on track for first monthly gain in 5 months
gist: GC=F $4,099.80 (-1.46%), below VWAP $4,104.45, capped under 4,134-4,143 supply, defended $4,081 demand twice; SI=F $57.695 (-2.24%); firm DXY/yields the main drag despite month-end safe-haven bid
